_about: Siberian Wellness ads for @sw.fidan (Fidan, Siberian Wellness independent consultant, Quba, delivery across Azerbaijan). Green + gold like her profile. Every time: the reel, a cover (green/gold, product + face, mouth closed) and a caption with a 'food supplement, not a medicine' note. Footage is usually AI presenter clips with the product box in the lower half: captions sit between chin and box, labels go to the empty side.
